briefing: NASDAQ +0.7% and S&P 500 +0.6% is a mild risk-on day, not the strong signal (+2%+) that has historically justified deploying cash. With only $289.29 in cash — below the $500 threshold — and no urgent setup among candidates, we're holding all 7 positions and waiting for a clearer risk-on confirmation before adding anything new.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: FOMO is the urge to buy just because you have open slots or idle cash, even when market signals aren't strong enough to justify it. Disciplined investors wait for genuine confirmation — like a sharp risk-on move — rather than forcing trades to feel productive.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: FOMO（錯失恐懼症）是指僅因為還有空餘倉位或閒置現金，就急於進場買入，即使市場訊號並不足以支持這個決定。有紀律的投資人會等待真正明確的訊號（例如強勁的風險偏好走勢），而不是為了「有動作」而勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: Markets edged higher today with modest gains across major indices, but the move lacked the strength of a decisive risk-on breakout. Without a sharp catalyst, this looks more like continuation drift than a new trend confirmation. We're treating it as a wait-and-see session rather than a buying opportunity.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤小幅走高，主要指數溫和上揚，但升幅未達強力風險偏好（risk-on）的水準。在缺乏明確催化因素的情況下，這較像是延續性的漂移走勢，而非新趨勢的確認。我們將今日視為觀望日，而非進場加碼的時機。
